textos.Lançado em 2024 e dirigido por Jon M. Ch: Released in 2024 and directed by Jon M. Chu, Wicked is a production that combines drama, romance and fantasy over its 161-minute running time. The story follows Elphaba, a young woman who deals with other people's incomprehension because of her green skin and seeks to understand her true powers upon entering Shiz University. In the academic setting, her path crosses that of Glinda, a popular, ambitious student, starting an unlikely friendship whose contrasts of ambition and principles affect the future of both in the Land of Oz.
